definitions.full: H6277. athaq עָתָק adjective forward, arrogant (of speech) (Thes free (see Arabic), unrestrained ); — 1Sam 2:3 ; Psa 31:19 ; 94:4 ; so also 75:6 (compare צַוָּאר ).
